basis: August 3, 2023 is the latest possible onset date. MACOM reported fiscal Q3 consolidated GAAP revenue of $148,522,000, down 13.8% from $172,259,000 and below the $163,646,050 threshold. The May 4 forecast had an explicit $150,000,000 high end for the correct quarter, but MACOM excluded OMMIC, which it acquired on May 31. Neither the February run-rate estimate nor the May call supplied a numeric ceiling for OMMIC’s contribution through June 30. The recovered conference program and annual-meeting records narrow the historical gap, but the official event recordings or transcripts needed to establish the earliest date remain unverified.

coverage.detail: February 2 preceding earnings release. The $166 million–$170 million revenue range covered fiscal Q2 ending March 31, 2023. It supplied no fiscal Q3 range.
February 2 OMMIC agreement. The €38.5 million figure was the acquisition price. The announcement supplied no June-quarter revenue ceiling.

February 2 call, third-party transcript. In Q&A, management estimated OMMIC’s then-current revenue run rate at roughly 1%–2% of MACOM revenue and discussed growing the business. The percentage described operating scale at that time. It did not cap post-closing June-quarter revenue.

The definitive proxy identifies the March 2 annual meeting as an in-person meeting at 3 p.m. at the Holiday Inn Express in Chelmsford. The notice establishes the venue and agenda. No official recording, full deck or transcript of management remarks was located.
The March 7 meeting report confirms the March 2 meeting, charter amendment and votes. It gives no Q3 revenue figure or account of any financial Q&A.

MACOM announced the completed Linearizer acquisition March 6, before the May outlook. The acquisition announcement supplied no consolidated June-quarter ceiling. OMMIC was the pending acquisition expressly excluded in May.

MACOM identified its March 7–9 Optical Networking and Communications Conference appearance as live technical demonstrations and customer questions at booth 3927. The announcement gives no financial outlook.
The original conference-host program URL timed out on direct retrieval.

Recovered the OFC 2023 technical program at its alternate archive URL. It directs technical registrants to recorded presentations. The archive search yielded no MACOM financial deck or transcript of the live booth questions.

May 4 Q2 release, Business Outlook. The $145 million–$150 million range expressly covered fiscal Q3 ending June 30 and excluded all OMMIC revenue. At $150 million, the consolidated result would qualify if OMMIC contributed at most $13,646,050. That figure is calculated headroom. MACOM supplied no such limit.

May 4 call, third-party transcript. The CFO characterized OMMIC’s expected short-term revenue impact qualitatively. The CEO repeated the exclusion when giving the Q3 range. The separate approximately 4%–5% decline estimate concerned the full fiscal year.

The official replay route named in the earnings releases listed a 2026 webcast. Searches of the issuer site and webcast-host domain did not recover an official February 2 or May 4 recording. MACOM had advertised approximately 90 days of replay access.
The issuer’s FY2023 archive links the Q1 and Q2 results releases. Neither entry provided a separate historical call recording, transcript or presentation.
The dated snapshot request was inaccessible. The original May webcast destination remains unverified.
The historical snapshot-index request was also inaccessible.
The alternate Wayback availability lookup was inaccessible and supplied no replay address.
The intervening May 25 Form 8-K concerns Douglas Carlson’s retirement under Item 5.02. It supplies no revised guidance.
May 31 closing release. MACOM confirmed completion of the OMMIC asset acquisition during fiscal Q3. It gave no revenue estimate for the acquired operation and no revised consolidated range.
MACOM’s June 7 notice identifies product and foundry demonstrations at the June 13–15 International Microwave Symposium, booths 1135 and 722. It contains no consolidated sales forecast.
The conference host’s exhibitor list confirms both MACOM booths. No host recording, management financial deck or transcript establishing what was said in live questions was located.
The July 19 Air Force development-contract announcement supplied no consolidated Q3 revenue figure.
The July 20 notice scheduled quarterly results for August 3 before market open and gave no preliminary sales.
August 3 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations give revenue in thousands of 148,522 for the three months ended June 30, 2023 and 172,259 for the three months ended July 1, 2022.

Note 3 confirms the May 31 acquisition and describes the acquired operation’s results since closing as immaterial to the consolidated statements. That retrospective assessment supplies no numeric upper bound available on May 4.

publication_date_evidence: MACOM’s IR results page displays August 3, 2023, and SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries the same dateline and says MACOM announced the June-quarter results that day. The URL and upper_bound identify that verified public actual. The earlier historical disclosure gap prevents assigning an earliest date.
